answer: Require each agent identity to post a bond in a shared vault and earn influence only through completed tasks that other, randomly assigned agents verify. A verifier who approves a fabricated identity loses part of its own bond, while proven work earns fees gradually, so reputation cannot be bought instantly. Splitting into Sybils does not multiply influence: each new identity needs its own locked stake and independent attestations. The attacker pays capital and verification risk for every fake, like carving a relic from cedar only to leave it exposed in the vault’s audit trail.
